# Incant Rapier 0.36.0 patch

`INCANT_UPSTREAM.json` hashes every original registry file. Preserve the upstream
license text copied from its published VCS commit, recorded in
`INCANT_LICENSE.json`; the upstream registry archives omit that file. The pinned tree has no root or Rapier kernel NOTICE file.
The code additions are under the default-off `incant-checkpoint` feature:
bounded trusted capture/install of serde-skipped persistent-island sleep scans,
and a borrowed read-only observation of the serde-skipped CCD fixed-target cache.
The CCD getter preserves uninitialized/list/full-BVH states, prediction bits and
list order. It adds no install or restore path. `INCANT_CCD_CAPTURE.json` pins
this isolated CCD source delta; `INCANT_UPSTREAM.json` remains the original inventory.
All solver algorithms, serde formats, default features and version stay unchanged.
This adapter is diagnostic infrastructure, not hostile save admission. It requires
an independently matched completed native owner; shape, manager and journal
validation is not provided by a sleep-scan stamp check.

The read-only pipeline observer is also gated by `incant-checkpoint`.
`INCANT_PIPELINE_CAPTURE.json` pins its copied verdict/deferred/quarantine
metadata and additive exports. It does not authenticate a completed phase, join
a task, clear poison or install state; all native algorithms remain unchanged.

The same default-off feature exposes a separately pinned trusted live-to-live
`checkpoint_fresh_workspace` experiment. It refuses deferred/quarantined owners,
retains exact historical CCD verdict and shares any configured execution pool,
while resetting other scratch/counters. It neither accepts records nor proves
phase or scratch completeness. `INCANT_TRUSTED_WORKSPACE.json` layers these
additions over the recorded historical pipeline-capture hashes. The current
capture inventory reflects the additive exports. Generic live
restoration and physics save admission remain disabled.

The separate default-off `incant-checked-restore` feature adds numerical
preflight of the joined inert frame through an optional dependency on the
std-only snapshot crate. It has no native graph/world constructor or installer.
`INCANT_CHECKED_ADMISSION.json` binds this layer and its prior hashes; upstream
solver routines are unchanged. The public runtime does not enable this feature.
